readmeExcerpt: This is a super simple game loosely based on Minesweeper Flags and runs on the IBM Quantum computer or simulator. Rules of the game: Don't explode the cat (bombs) The tile numbers indicate the number of times you need to click on the same colour to reveal the whole group If a tile has an ! at the end that means quantum probability was not in your favour and that tile click does not count To win the game, find the golden kitty (who moves based on whether you reveal a ! or normal tile)
